system.description:
Advanced Move. You no longer have to touch someone to Atone for them. When you petition your deity to perform a great miracle that pertains to their domains, tell the GM what you desire, they will give you a number of appropriate conditions based on the guidelines below, or say no. Like with Atone, you can spend Spirit like Armor to absorb conditions gained from Thaumaturgy.

1 Condition - Feed a large crowd
2 Conditions - Calm a raging storm
3 Conditions - Foresee an Ominous Force
4 Conditions - Summon a divine envoy
5 Conditions - Destroy or reshape a land
